*Celebrating Women Who Mediate Peace* 💪🇮🇳 
 
This Independence Day, MedArb International & DRF Conflict Management Solutions LLP bring together global women leaders for the *Global Symposium on Family Mediation*. 
 
From High Conflict Mediation to Co-Parenting, Matrimonial Property to Cultural Dimensions — hear from 6 distinguished women speakers shaping the future of family conflict resolution worldwide. 
 
📅 15 Aug 2026 | ⏰ 10:00 AM - 12:30 PM IST | 💻 Virtual | 🎟️ Free 
 
Because freedom is not just about independence of a nation. 
It’s about harmony in homes, communities, and beyond. 
 
Register today: 
 
🌐 https://lnkd.in/gayMbejU

comment: Family mediation outcomes often depend less on the settlement terms and more on rebuilding communication patterns. Training mediators to address power dynamics and long-term co-parenting realities is equally essential.
